en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of an industrial dam and hydroelectric facility on a river. In the foreground a large spillway and cylindrical structure release water, with small control houses and machinery on top of the dam. Behind the dam stand factory buildings with a tall smokestack and, further back, scattered houses and forested hills. In the bottom left corner there is a printed caption.
